treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Finland and the Republic of Poland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2009, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: ... sopimus, jonka hyväksymistä koskevat nootit on vaihdettu 9 päivänä helmikuuta 2010, tulee voimaan 11 päivänä maaliskuuta 2010 niin kuin siitä on sovittu.
source_title: Finlex up-to-date income tax treaties: Synthesised text of the MLI and the FI–PL Convention (SopS 20-21/2010)

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which controls directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of [the Convention]. | ... paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI has effect ... with respect to taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited to nonresidents, where the event giving rise to such taxes occurs on or after 2020-01-01

notes: Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)-(4)) when paid to governments/central banks/state-owned institutions, on export-promotion loans granted/insured/guaranteed by governmental institutions (incl. Finnfund, Finnish Export Credit, Finnvera, KUKE, BGK), on credit sales of equipment, and on any loan granted by a bank — bank-loan tier not modelled. Treaty WHT effect: income derived on or after 1 January following 2010 EIF = 2011-01-01. MLI arts 5, 6, 7, 9 apply; no Art. 8 holding period.
